title: Ukraine defense tech firm Uforce raises US$700 million, eyes Asia-Pacific production, Taiwan suppliers
html:
Uforce, a defense technology company founded in Ukraine and headquartered in the UK, announced the completion of a US$700 million Series A funding round...

The article requires paid subscription. Subscribe Now
summary: Ukraine-founded defense tech firm UFORCE completed a US$700 million Series A funding round, which will be used to help expand R&D of its unmanned systems and expand capacity.
